vx._source: Parameter lists and specs published by ProTee at proteegroup.com/the-power-of-vx. Do not add a data point that is not on their list.
vx.noMarkers: No club stickers. No marked balls. No floor sensors.
vx.handedness: Right- and left-handed play, switched instantly.

cards.name: Ball Speed
cards.blurb: How fast the ball leaves the face. The single biggest lever on distance.

cards.name: Swing Path
cards.blurb: The direction the club is travelling through impact — the start of every draw and fade.

cards.name: Spin Axis
cards.blurb: The tilt on the ball that decides whether it holds its line or curves.

cards.name: Attack Angle
cards.blurb: Whether you are striking up or down on the ball at contact.

cards.name: Carry Distance
cards.blurb: How far the ball actually flies before it first touches the ground.

cards.name: Impact Point
cards.blurb: Where on the face you struck it, vertically and horizontally.

cards.name: Descent Angle
cards.blurb: How steeply the ball comes down, and whether it will hold a green.

cards.name: Launch Angle
cards.blurb: The angle the ball leaves the ground on — the other half of distance.

vx.cardsNote: Every card is a parameter the ProTee VX measures. `image` is empty on purpose: drop in a real screenshot filename and that card renders the photo instead of the type treatment.
